<div class="card-body">
'''Red Leader''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レッド・リーダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼が操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋2。レッド1に乗っていれば、さらに回避値＋1し、戦闘運命数が引けない場合に、1枚だけ引ける。同じ位置にいるレッド中隊の他のパイロットは全員没収値に＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-29o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">Xウイングのパイロット、ガーヴェン・ドライス。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド中隊を率い、デス・スターの排熱孔に一発打ち込んだが、外れた。ダントウイン反乱軍基地に勤務していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Red Leader.

'''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 1, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Each other Red Squadron pilot at the same location is forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at Yavin and fired on the Death Star exhaust port, but missed. Served at the Dantooine Rebel base.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Red Leader]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
